audit_items.proof_trace: Every borrow — including each step in a repeated deposit-borrow leverage cycle — passes through `handle_borrow`, which applies the new debt to the obligation (line 412) and then unconditionally calls `is_obligation_safe` (lines 424-434), reverting the transaction if the check fails. `is_obligation_safe` (lines 1214-1249) computes collateral-weighted value vs. borrow-weighted debt and returns false when health is breached, so no unsafe borrow can succeed. No alternative borrow path exists; flash loans use a separate hot-potato mechanism that creates no obligation debt.
